seo.title: Careers | Steps AI
seo.description: Work on AI agents that answer real customers for small businesses. See how to get in touch with the Steps AI team.

hero.title: Help small businesses answer every customer.
hero.body: Steps AI is a small, founder-led team building AI agents for online stores and service businesses. We are always glad to hear from people who care about that problem.

sections.title: Open roles.
paragraphs: There are no open roles listed right now. If you think you could help, send us a short note about what you would like to work on.

items.title: Close to customers
items.body: Many features start as a request from a real customer, such as the shipment landed cost calculator.

items.title: Plain and honest
items.body: We write the way we speak to customers: clearly, and without overselling.

items.title: Small team, real ownership
items.body: Everyone ships work that customers use.
